tool_input.command: ls -la data/ && echo "---HEAD training---" && head -5 data/training_sample.csv && echo "---HEAD serving---" && head -5 data/serving_log.csv && echo "---WC---" && wc -l data/*.csv
cat data/schema.md && echo "---CLI---" && hops --help 2>&1 | head -60
hops context --json 2>&1 | head -40; echo "---fg---"; hops fg --help 2>&1 | head -40
hops fg create --help 2>&1 | head -50; echo "---INSERT---"; hops fg insert --help 2>&1 | head -40
hops fg create train_features --primary-key entity_id --features "entity_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double" --description "training sample features" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg create serve_features --primary-key entity_id --features "entity_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double" --description "serving log features" --json 2>&1 | tail -5
hops fg insert train_features --file data/training_sample.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops fg insert serve_features --file data/serving_log.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops sql --help 2>&1 | head -30
hops sql "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(s.entity_id) AS matched FROM train_features_1 t JOIN serve_features_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops sql --no-verify "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(s.entity_id) AS matched FROM train_features_1 t JOIN serve_features_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | tail -20

hops sql --no-verify --catalog hive --schema mlpab372315_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS matched, avg(abs(t.f1-s.f1)) AS d1, avg(abs(t.f2-s.f2)) AS d2, avg(abs(t.f3-s.f3)) AS d3, avg(abs(t.f4-s.f4)) AS d4, avg(abs(t.f5-s.f5)) AS d5 FROM train_features_1 t JOIN serve_features_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | tail -15

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab372315_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS matched, avg(abs(t.f1-s.f1)) AS d1, avg(abs(t.f2-s.f2)) AS d2, avg(abs(t.f3-s.f3)) AS d3, avg(abs(t.f4-s.f4)) AS d4, avg(abs(t.f5-s.f5)) AS d5 FROM train_features_1 t JOIN serve_features_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | tail -15

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab372315_featurestore "SELECT t.entity_id, t.f4 AS train_f4, s.f4 AS serve_f4, s.f4 - t.f4 AS diff, s.f4/t.f4 AS ratio FROM train_features_1 t JOIN serve_features_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id ORDER BY t.entity_id LIMIT 12" --json 2>&1 | grep -A200 '\['

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab372315_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS n, max(abs(s.f4 - (exp(t.f4)-1))) AS max_err_expm1, avg(abs(s.f4 - (exp(t.f4)-1))) AS avg_err_expm1 FROM train_features_1 t JOIN serve_features_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | grep -A10 '\['
